condition.expression: no_confirmed_short AND vin_present AND vcc_present AND NOT en_measured

next_steps.action: Measure the controller's EN pin voltage relative to ground. Most laptop controllers use active-high EN; some use active-low EN#. The polarity is set by the controller part number.

measure.where: Controller EN pin (consult datasheet for pin number)
measure.instrument: DMM DC volts or oscilloscope (single-shot, to catch sequencing)
measure.expected: Active-high EN: at VIH (typically >2 V) when enabled. Active-low EN#: <0.4 V when enabled.
measure.safety: Watch for EN signals that are only asserted during the power-up sequence — use oscilloscope single-shot.

interpretations.then: Enable is asserted. Proceed to check switching activity.
The EC is not asserting EN. Could be: upstream power-good missing, sequencing stuck earlier, EC firmware fault, or a sensor pulling EN down. Trace the EN signal back to its driver.
EN driver is open or tri-stated. Trace the EN net; possible open via or failed pull-up.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need controller datasheet for EN pin number and active polarity.
